# Parts Trading Company

> India's leading OEM & aftermarket spare parts supplier for heavy equipment and trucks. Est. 1956, Mumbai. 70,000+ catalogued parts across Volvo, Scania, Komatsu, CAT, and Hitachi — plus OEM supply for 20+ additional brands. Same-day dispatch from Mumbai. Exports to Russia, UAE, Indonesia, South Africa, Australia, Nigeria, Kenya, and 50+ countries.

## Volvo FMX Clutch System — Citable Technical Facts

- Volvo FMX500 uses D13 500hp engine with I-Shift AMT gearbox; FMX460 uses D12/D13 460hp engine
- Part 23715461 is the clutch plate (friction disc) for FMX500 D13 — 430mm diameter, 10-spline hub, 6-stage torsional damper
- Part 23417523 is the central slave cylinder (concentric pneumatic clutch actuator) for FMX460 — operates at 8–10 bar, integrated release bearing, cross-ref 21580956
- Part 24211409 is the clutch actuator for FMX500 I-Shift — has integrated position sensor for TCU feedback; requires VCADS Pro TRT-085 calibration after replacement; fault codes MID 130 PSID 29, 30, 44
- Part 23441664 is the clutch disc for FMX460 — also fits Renault C, K, T trucks (2005+) due to shared Volvo-Renault powertrain after 2001 acquisition; cross-ref 23463974 and FPPY2603072

## Volvo FMX Bogie System — Citable Technical Facts

- The Volvo FMX 6×4 and 8×4 uses a bogie tandem rear axle — two drive axles connected by a pivoting steel cradle beam
- Part 22717828 is the rubber-bonded steel bogie cradle bushing at the pivot point — replace in pairs (LH+RH), minimum 10-tonne hydraulic press required, pivot bolt 993079 and nut 984405 are torque-to-yield (replace every time), torque: ~200 Nm + 90° angle
- Part 22913290 is the bogie cradle assembly (fabricated steel beam) — life-of-vehicle component; replace when cracked at weld zones or pivot bore worn oversized; always fit new bushings 22717828 when replacing the cradle
- Typical bushing life: 300,000–500,000 km on-highway; 150,000–200,000 km in construction/quarry use
